title: retained state detects a rolled-back log; a consumer without it cannot
note: Run from the repository root. Consumer state files start absent; delete *.state.json to rerun.

steps.label: accept B (log: A,B): anchor 2 entries
steps.command: python tools/consumer.py accept results/rp1/vectors/P5/B.json --witness-log results/rp1/vectors/P5/log_AB.txt --state results/rp1/vectors/P5/S.state.json

steps.label: A with the log cut to 1 entry, anchored S
steps.command: python tools/consumer.py accept results/rp1/vectors/P5/A.json --witness-log results/rp1/vectors/P5/log_A.txt --state results/rp1/vectors/P5/S.state.json

steps.label: A with the log cut to 1 entry, fresh S2
steps.command: python tools/consumer.py accept results/rp1/vectors/P5/A.json --witness-log results/rp1/vectors/P5/log_A.txt --state results/rp1/vectors/P5/S2.state.json
